Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are making their way out in the middle now. Theertha Satish and Lavanya Keny are the two openers for United Arab Emirates Women Under-19. Shabnam MD to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, India Women Under-19 have posted a mammoth total on the board here. They would feel confident of defending this. United Arab Emirates Women Under-19, on the other hand should see this as an oppurtunity for their batters to find some form and get runs under their belt. Let's see how the chase unfolds.

United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 never got going in this innings and their fielding was not up to the mark. If you miss so many chances at this level, you will get punished and that is exactly what happened. Their bowling looked lackluster and were put under the sword by the Indian batters. However, after getting the wicket of Shafali Verma, they pulled things slightly back for them. In the end though, they would feel that they did a good job keeping their opponents under 220 as India were 127/1 at the halfway mark. Indhuja Nandakumar, Mahika Gaur and Samaira Dharnidharka all got one wicket each.

India Women Under-19 absolutely took apart the UAE bowling apart right from the start. They got 12 runs off the first over and never looked back. Shafali Verma showed her class and was only dealing with boundaries with Shweta Sehrawat providing the required support from the other while putting away the loose deliveries as well. Verma looked set to register a century, but she holed out on 78 off just 34 balls. She along with Shweta added 111 runs for the first wicket. However, after that Richa Ghosh came on and continued the onslaught. She was also given a few lives from the fielders and took full advantage of it. She finally got dismissed for 49 and missed her half century. Shweta Sehrawat remained unbeaten on 74 off 49 balls, but they just could not finish their innings with flurry in the end.
A dominant batting display from India Women Under-19! They have posted the highest total of this competion so far and looked a like a team on another level.

A length ball, sliding down leg. Soniya Mendhiya looks to flick it, but misses as the ball goes off her pads to the left of the keeper. The batters are able to sneak a quick leg bye here. They take one. India Women Under-19 end their innings at 219/3.
Length and on off. Hit down to long on for a single.
Just short of the fielder in the deep. Much fuller, on middle Soniya Mendhiya heaves it down the ground. It hands in the air for a long time but meets the fielder on a bounce. One more taken.
Back of a length, on the body, it hurries onto the batter. Shweta Sehrawat gets a thick outside edge on it. It chips towards the square leg region and lands safely. One taken.

High in the air...SAFE! It is a length ball, on middle and leg. Soniya Mendhiya looks to flick it away but gets a leading edge on it. The ball goes towards short mid-wicket. Vaishnave Mahesh puts in a forward dive but the ball lands safely. One taken.

OUT! CAUGHT! Samaira Dharnidharka strikes this time and gets a wicket here. It is a short ball, on off. Gongadi Trisha hangs back and goes for the hook shot. The ball takes the outside edge and lobs to the left of the batter. Theertha Satish calls for it instantly, comes forward and takes a dolly.
Commentary.Howout: c Theertha Satish b Samaira Dharnidharka

Commentary.Commentary: Soniya Mendhiya walks out to bat now.
WIDE! Samaira Dharnidharka goes full, way outside the tramline. Gongadi Trisha does not bother as the umpire signals a wide.
Samaira Dharnidharka to bowl the last over.
Back of a length, on top of off. Shweta Sehrawat rocks back and heaves it towards long on. The fielder does well to make a half-stop, as the ball is dipping in front of her in the deep. Two taken.
Fuller, on fifth stump. Trisha slices it to deep point and crosses.
A length ball, around off. Gongadi Trisha punches it through covers for two runs.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries. It is a short ball, on the bodyline. Trisha gets inside the line and helps it over short fine for another boundary.

FOUR! Gongadi Trisha is off the mark with a boundary. A short ball, wide outside off. Gongadi Trisha gets it to fly off the outside edge as she tries ot cut it away. The ball goes to deep point and into the fence.
Gongadi Trisha comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Richa Ghosh does not get lucky the fifth time. It is full, outside off. Ghosh shuffles across and tries to scoop it away, but hits it off the toe-end. It lobs behind the keeper. Theertha Satish back-pedals and takes an easy catch to see the back of Ghosh.
Commentary.Howout: c Theertha Satish b Mahika Gaur

Commentary.Commentary: DROPPED AGAIN! This is back of a length and on off, Richa Ghosh swings across the line, but gets a top edge towards mid off where the fielder gets under it, but fails to grab it. Nothing is going n the way for United Arab Emirates Women Under-19. A single is taken.
Back of a length and on off, Shweta Sehrawat slaps it towards sweeper cover for a run.

DROPPED! This is on a good length and on off, Richa Ghosh slices it up in the air. The fielder from extra cover runs forward, but only manages to get some fingertips and spills it. The batters cross for  a run.
SIX! BOOM! This is full and on off, Richa Ghosh gets inside the line and heaves it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
A length ball, on middle and leg. Shweta Sehrawat tries to heave it across the line. The ball goes to square leg off the inside edge. One taken.
FOUR! Full length, wide outside off. Shweta Sehrawat throws her bat at it. The ball takes the outside edge and flies down to third man for four runs.
Length and on off. Shweta Sehrawat pushes it to cover for a quick single.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer, on leg. Shweta Sehrawat ducks under it. Wided.
A single now as this is pushed to point.
Halt! Siya Gokhale looks to have hurt her fingers while trying to take the catch on the previous delivery. The physio is checking up on her out off the field.

DROPPED! Richa Ghosh remains at the crease as another catch is dropped in the deep. It is on a full length, on middle and leg. Ghosh looks to flick it away. It flies off the outside edge towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep has enough time to track it down but is unable to pouch it. A couple of runs taken.
FOUR! Top shot! It is overpitched, on off. Ghosh holds her pose this time and lofts it over mid off for four runs.
Full, drifting down leg. Shweta Sehrawat clips it to the left of short fine leg for a quick single.
Fuller, outside off. Ghosh shuffles and tries to scoop it away. It goes to short fine leg off the inner half. Single taken.
Mahika Gaur is back on.
FOUR! Incredible shot. It is full, wide outside off. Shweta Sehrawat shuffles across a long way and paddle sweeps it over square leg for four runs.
Shorter, outside off. Shweta Sehrawat looks to chase it but misses.
On off, tapped to point.

Dropped! Richa Ghosh gets a lifeline this time. It is full and on off. Richa Ghosh looks to slog it away but gets it off the top-edge. The ball hangs in the air for a long time which gives enough time to Vaishnave Mahesh to settle under it, but spills it out in the end at deep mid-wicket. One taken.
Much better length from Indhuja Nandakumar. Slightly fuller, outside off. Richa Ghosh drives it to cover, the fielder does well to make a sharp stop.

SIX! This goes all the way. Effortless stroke. Back of a length, outside off, it nips back in. Richa Ghosh goes back and smokes it over the long on fence for a maximum. Indhuja Nandakumar under pressure instantly.
A bit short and on off, Shweta Sehrawat slices it uppishly but through cover-point for a brace.
Fires this full but way outside off, Shweta Sehrawat leaves it alone. Wided.
FOUR! Shweta Sehrawat finds the fence! This is flatter, full and on middle, Shweta Sehrawat nails her sweep towards thed deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Short again and on off, Shweta Sehrawat chops it towards point.
Shortish and on off, Richa Ghosh cuts it towards sweeper cover for one.
Floated, full and on off, Richa Ghosh moves across but only manages to knock it off the inner half down the pitch.
In the air...safe! This is tossed up, full and on off, Richa Ghosh goes for the slog-sweep, but gets a top edge. Luckily for her it lands safely in the deep square leg region. Two runs taken!
Shorte in length and on off, Shweta Sehrawat pushes it towards extra covers.

Tossed up and around off, Shweta Sehrawat comes down the track to slog it away, but gets an outside edge towards the third man fence where the fieder chase and puts in a good dive to keep it in. Two runs taken!
Another short delivery, on off, Richa Ghosh cuts it towards deep point for a single.
FOUR! Nice placement! This is short again and outside off, Richa Ghosh frees her arms and slaps it towards the deep point fence for a boundary.
FIFTY FOR SEHRWAT! This is her second fifty of the tournament and she has continued her good form. This is short and on off, Shweta Sehrawat cuts it towards cover-point where a fumble allows a run.
Looped up, full and on off, Shweta Sehrawat drives it to the left of the bowler where Archara Supriya runs and fields it well.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Shweta Sehrawat cuts it towards deep point for a run.
FOUR! Easy pickings! This is flighted, full and on middle, Shweta Sehrawat goes down and sweeps it towards the vacant deep square leg fence for a boundary.

Play halted! The physio comes out rushing on the field. Shweta Sehrawat seems to be in some pain. She is down on the floor and is getting nursed as I type. It looks like she is fine and back on her feet.

Ouch! That must have hurt! Lavanya Keny tosses it up, full and on middle, Shweta Sehrawat uses her feet and drills it down the pitch, but the ball hits Richa Ghosh on her foot at the non-striker's end. This was travelling and would have been a boundary.
Flighted, short and on off, Shweta Sehrawat pushes it towards covers.

FOUR! Good shot! This is floated, full and on middle, Shweta Sehrawat slogs it towards the deep mid-wicket fence where the fielder dives to her right and tries to stop it with her foot, but it deflects for a boundary.
Tossed up, full and on off, Shweta Sehrawat goes down and tries to sweep it away, but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW, but turned down.

Short again and on off, Shweta Sehrawat punches off the back foot towards sweeper cover for one more. Only three runs from the over! A sigh of relief for the United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 players.
Shortish and on outside off, Richa Ghosh cuts past point for a run.
Ripper! Vaishnave Mahesh tosses this up, full and on middle, turning away slightly, Richa Ghosh prods forward to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
A googly now, short and on middle, turning in, Richa Ghosh makes room and pushes it towards covers.
Slower through the air, on off, turning away a bit, Richa Ghosh looks to cut it away, but fails to connect.
Looped up, full and on off, Shweta Sehrawat forces it towards long off for a single.
FOUR! Richa Ghosh finds the gap this time! Indhuja Nandakumar bowls this a tad shorter and outside off, Richa Ghosh cuts it past point for a boundary.
Fuller one and on off, Richa Ghosh drives it towards extra covers.
Length again and on off, Shweta Sehrawat punches it towards sweeper cover for one.
This is on a good length and on off, Richa Ghosh taps it to the off side and scampers across for a quick run.
Back of a length and outside off, slower too, Richa Ghosh cuts it straight to point.
Short of a length and way outside off, Shweta Sehrawat slaps it through covers for a single.

Drinks! India Women Under-19 are on 127/1 at the halfway mark. Shafali Verma was looking like she would get to her hundred, but she got out trying to be a little too agressive. However, their focus now will be to post a mammoth total on the board with Richa Ghosh still on the crease and Shweta Sehrawat set on the other end. United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 will need a couple of quick wicets to stop the run flow or else they could get blown away.

Quite short, outside off. Ghosh waits for it and dabs it down to the right of short third. The fielder there dives to her right and gets a hand on it. She parries it towards deep point. Two taken before the fielder cuts it out.
Another single now as this is pushed to the off side once again.
Flighted, full and outside off. Ghosh drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Top placement. Archara Supriya drags her length back, around off. Richa Ghosh goes back and punches it through the gap between cover and extra cover for four runs.
Shweta Sehrawat stays back to this short ball and cuts it hard towards point. The fielder there dives to her right and makes a half-stop. They only get one.
It is short, outside off, turning away. Shweta Sehrawat looks to chase it but misses.
Archara Supriya has been introduced into the attack now.
On off, driven into the off side for a single. A successful over comes to an end but rather an expensive one.
WIDE! This is spilled outside off, way beyond the tramline. Shweta Sehrawat lets it be.
A single now as Ghosh taps this full ball to the off side.
FOUR! Well, as of now they cannot. India Women Under-19 batters aren't letting the bowlers settle here. It is a short ball, outside off. Ghosh cuts it late, past backward point for four runs.
Richa Ghosh walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! The United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 camp is delighted. There are loud cheers across the ground now, as Indhuja Nandakumar gets rid of Shafali Verma who was only dealing in boundaries at the moment. Verma goes looking for another one but holes out this time. It is full and on off. Shafali Verma miscues her shot and lofts it straight down to long off. Mahika Gaur settels under it and takes a sharp catch. Can United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 now build on this wicket?
Commentary.Howout: c Mahika Gaur b Indhuja Nandakumar

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Shafali Verma is only dealing in boundaries at the moment. She races away to 78 runs off just 33 balls. Indhuja Nandakumar serves it short, outside off. Verma slaps it over covers and gets a boundary.

SIX! Change in bowling does not bring a change in fortune for United Arab Emirates Women Under-19. It is full swinging down leg. Shafali Verma uses her wrists really well here and flicks it over the square leg fence.
Indhuja Nandakumar comes back into the attack now. She conceded 12 runs in the first over.

FOUR! The runs are coming in thick and fast! India Women Under-19 gets across the 100-run mark in just 8 overs. It is shorter, outside off. Shweta Sehrawat rocks back and slaps it hard to the left of extra cover. The fielder there tumbles to her left but is unable to stop the ball. It sneaks through and reaches the fence.
Short, outside off. Verma cuts it hard to covers. There is a misfield whic allows Verma to cross.
SIX! She goes downtown this time, but the result is the same. It is overpitched, on middle. Verma comes down the track and lofts it over the long on fence.
SIX! All the way! It is fuller and on off. Verma goes down on one knee and smokes it over the wide long on fence for a biggie.
Full and outside off. Shweta Sehrawat drives it along the ground down to long off for a single.
Half a chance! It is tossed up, outside off. Verma goes for the sweep. The ball takes the top edge and flies over the keeper. They take one as the fielder from short third man chases it down.
Lavanya Keny comes into the attack now.
FOUR! Shweta Sehrawat now joins the party. It is full and on off. Shweta Sehrawat gets low and sweeps it through square leg. This is hit powerfully and reaches the fence in a flash.
A single now as Verma works it towards mid on.

FOUR! Deft touch! Shafali Verma gets her half-century in just 26 balls. Her first one in this tournament. It is quite short, outside off. Verma waits for it guides it down to short third man. The fielder there fumbles and lets the ball through here. It goes down to the third man fence.
Back of a length, once again, outside off. Shweta Sehrawat cuts it to deep point and takes a single.
Shorter, going down leg. Shweta Sehrawat stays back and pulls it to deep square leg for two more.
Loops it up, full and on middle. Shweta Sehrawat pushes it to covers with soft hands and takes off. There is an overthrow which allows the batters to sneak another single.
FOUR! Another boundary to end the over! This is overpitched and around off, Shafali Verma carves it through extra covers for four more runs.
Sharp bumper! Mahika Gaur bangs in a bouncer, on middle, Shafali Verma ducks under it.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Mahika Gaur bowls this on a good length and on mShafali Verma forces it towards long on where the fielder overruns the ball a bit and lets it through for another boundary for Verma,

FOUR! Nice use of the feet! This is pitched up, on middle, Shafali Verma comes takes a couple of steps and clips it towards the deep mid-wicket fence. The fielder form mid-wicket chase it, dives forward to stop it, but her efforts goes in vain.
This is on a good length and on middle, Shafali Verma blocks it out.

Overthrows! This is poor cricket from United Arab Emirates Women Under-19. Mahika Gaur starts with a slower delivery, full and on middle, Shweta Sehrawat looks to flick it away, but gets an inside edge onto her pads as the ball rolls towards square leg. The batters sets off for the run, and the fielder hits the stumps at the batter's end with Verma well inside the crease. The deflects away and beats the fielders on the off side to run away to the sweeper cover fence for a boundary.
Change. Mahika Gaur (1-0-12-0) is back into the attack now.
Short of a length and outside off, Shafali Verma chops it off the inner half towards the keeper.
SIX! BANG!  Samaira Dharnidharka bowls a full toss, on middle and leg, Shafali Verma whips it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie. 50 up for India Women Under-19!
Overpitched and on off, Shweta Sehrawat drills it towards covers for a run.
Back of a length and on off, Shafali Verma dabs it towards point and sets off for the run. The fielder picks up and hits the stumps at the bowler's end, but Verma is in.
Full again and on off, Shafali Verma drives it towards mid off.
Full and on off, Shafali Verma drives it towards the bowler where Samaira Dharnidharka gets down quickly to her left to stop it.
Floated, full and on middle, Shafali Verma sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Another one! Vaishnave Mahesh slows it up and lands this short, on middle, Shafali Verma waits for it and lofts it towards the long off fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is looped up, full and on middle, Shafali Verma goes down and sweeps it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Short and on outside off, Shafali Verma cuts it towards cover-point.

Not a wide! It is slower through the air, shorter, wide outside off. It grips and turns away, which takes it outside the tramline. Shafali Verma though shuffles across a long way and the umpire does not signal a wide.
FOUR! Up and over! Vaishnave Mahesh starts with a loosener. A full toss, outside off. Shafali Verma gets low and slogs it over mid-wicket. A couple of bounces into the ropes.

Length and on off. Verma pushes it to the off side and crosses. India Women Under-19 have got 30 runs here in no time. United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 need to break this stand which is not holding back at all.
FOUR! Shafali Verma finds the gap this time. This is full, straying on the pads. Verma hangs back and clips it past mid on. It races away to the fence.
An appeal for lbw but turned down! It is an inswinger, full and on leg. Shafali Verma comes down the track and tries to flick it away but takes a blow on her toes.
A single now as Shweta Sehrawat taps it to point.
Fuller, angled into the pads. It turns out to be a low full toss. Shweta Sehrawat nudges it to the leg side.
Swing and a miss! Samaira Dharnidharka starts with a short on, outside off. Shweta Sehrawat tries to cut it away but misses.
On off, defended out.
FOUR! NIcely played. Back of a length, in the channel. Verma waits for it and steers it down to third man for four runs.
A touch fuller and on off, Shafali Verma knocks it towards covers.
Back of a length and on off, Shafali Verma blocks it to the off side.

FOUR! Best shot of the match so far! This is full again and on middle, Shafali Verma shows the full face of the bat and drives it straight past the bowler for a boundary. She holds the pose for the cameras. India Women Under-19 off to a good start here.
FOUR! Shafali Verma gets off the mark with a boundary! Mahika Gaur begins with a full delivery around leg, Shafali Verma clips it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Mahika Gaur to share the new ball.

FOUR! Three boundaries in the over! This is a bit short again and on the fifth stump line, Shweta Sehrawat slashes and gets an thick outside edge towards the third man fence for four more runs. 12 runs from the first over!
FOUR! Deft touch! This is on a good length and on off, shaping in, Shweta Sehrawat waits for it and guides it late towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Goes fuller this time, on off, Shweta Sehrawat mistimes her drive towards mid off.

FOUR! Shweta Sehrawat and India Women Under-19 are underway in style! Indhuja Nandakumar lands this short of a length and outside off, Shweta Sehrawat stays there and punches it through covers for a boundary.
This is on a good length and around off, Shweta Sehrawat pushes it towards covers.
BEATEN! Indhuja Nandakumar starts with a hard-length delivery, outside off, Shweta Sehrawat looks to cut it away, but misses it.

The match is set to begin. The two umpires make their way out on the track. Soon, United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 players take the field. Followed by Shweta Sehrawat and Shafali Verma who walk out to open for India Women Under-19. Indhuja Nandakumar to start with the new ball.

PITCH REPORT - Mignon du Preez is near the deck. She informs that there is no green grass and it is a firm wicket. Adds that there will be a lot of bounce and the batters can trust that and play their shots, and the pacers will get some help from the pitch. Tells that there is not going to be a lot of turn and overall it is a good batting deck.

Shafali Verma, the skipper of India Women Under-19 is in for a chat. She says that the wicket can be a bit slow. Adds that they will judge the wicket early and hopefully get a hang of it quickly. Mentions that there a couple of changes in the side.

Theertha Satish, the captian of United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 says that they will bowl first. Adds that they are sticking to their strengths and process and not looking at the opponent. Tells that in the end it is all about executing on the field. Informs they are unchanged.

India Women Under-19 (Playing XI) - Shweta Sehrawat, Shafali Verma (C), Gongadi Trisha, Richa Ghosh (WK), Soniya Mendhiya, Hrishita Basu, Titas Sadhu (In for Soumya Tiwari), Archana Devi, Mannat Kashyap (In for Sonam Yadav), Parshavi Chopra, Shabnam MD.

United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 (Unchanged Playing XI) - Theertha Satish (C/ WK), Lavanya Keny, Samaira Dharnidharka, Mahika Gaur, Rinitha Rajith, Vaishnave Mahesh, Archara Supriya, Siya Gokhale, Indhuja Nandakumar, Geethika Jyothis, Avanee Patil.
TOSS - United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 have won the toss and they have elected to BOWL first.

United Arab Emirates Women Under-19 also are coming into this game with a win on their back. They look like a solid unit but need to bring their A-game if they are to get the better of this opposition. It certainly won't be a walk in the park for them like the first match. Who will get over the line? We shall find out soon, as the toss isn't far away.

Hello and a warm welcome to all! It is now time for match number 9 in the Women's Under-19 T20 World Cup. In this match India Women Under-19 will be locking horns against United Arab Emirates Women Under-19. India Women Under-19 are one of the favourites in the competition and would be aiming to extend their winning run in this competition. India Women U-19 were a bit lenient with the ball and would hope to tighten things us this time around.
... MATCH DAY ...
